messages.subject: actionButton to alter slider value
parts:
If a slider has a lot of possible values it can be difficult to slide to a specific number. To help users, I would like to give them the option to select a value by (1) using a slider, (2) pressing a "next" button that increases the value of the slider by 1, or (3) pressing a "last" button that decreases the value of the slider. I suspect this is possible using an actionButton, but I'm having trouble implementing this.

Does anyone have suggestions?

Thanks a lot, and love the package.
